entries.title: Psalms 7:1
segments: ¶<<A Meditation of David, which he sang to the LORD concerning the words of Cush, a Benjamite.>> O LORD my God, in You I put my trust; Save me from all those who persecute me; And deliver me,

entries.title: Psalms 7:2
segments: Lest they tear me like a lion, Rending [me] in pieces, while [there is] none to deliver.

entries.title: Psalms 7:3
segments: O LORD my God, if I have done this: If there is iniquity in my hands,

entries.title: Psalms 7:4
segments: If I have repaid evil to him who was at peace with me, Or have plundered my enemy without cause,

entries.title: Psalms 7:5
segments: Let the enemy pursue me and overtake [me]; Yes, let him trample my life to the earth, And lay my honor in the dust. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 7:6
segments: Arise, O LORD, in Your anger; Lift Yourself up because of the rage of my enemies; Rise up for me [to] the judgment You have commanded!

entries.title: Psalms 7:7
segments: So the congregation of the peoples shall surround You; For their sakes, therefore, return on high.

entries.title: Psalms 7:8
segments: The LORD shall judge the peoples; Judge me, O LORD, according to my righteousness, And according to my integrity within me.

entries.title: Psalms 7:9
segments: Oh, let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end, But establish the just; For the righteous God tests the hearts and minds.

entries.title: Psalms 7:10
segments: ¶My defense [is] of God, Who saves the upright in heart.

entries.title: Psalms 7:11
segments: God [is] a just judge, And God is angry [with the wicked] every day.

entries.title: Psalms 7:12
segments: If he does not turn back, He will sharpen His sword; He bends His bow and makes it ready.

entries.title: Psalms 7:13
segments: He also prepares for Himself instruments of death; He makes His arrows into fiery shafts.

entries.title: Psalms 7:14
segments: Behold, [the wicked] brings forth iniquity; Yes, he conceives trouble and brings forth falsehood.

entries.title: Psalms 7:15
segments: He made a pit and dug it out, And has fallen into the ditch [which] he made.

entries.title: Psalms 7:16
segments: His trouble shall return upon his own head, And his violent dealing shall come down on his own crown.

entries.title: Psalms 7:17
segments: I will praise the LORD according to His righteousness, And will sing praise to the name of the LORD Most High.
